events.title: Watch Burlington’s partial lunar eclipse
events.dateLabel: Thu, Aug. 27 · partial phase at 10:33 p.m.
events.location: Visible across Burlington with a clear view of the sky
events.summary: The partial eclipse begins at 10:33 p.m. and reaches maximum at 12:12 a.m.
events.details: The penumbral phase starts at 9:23 p.m. The partial phase starts at 10:33 p.m., reaches maximum at 12:12 a.m. and ends at 1:51 a.m. No eye protection is required for a lunar eclipse.
events.imageAlt: Night-sky illustration above the Niagara Escarpment. Not a Burlington photograph of this eclipse.
events.venue: Anywhere with a clear view of the sky

events.title: Movies Under the Stars: Ice Princess
events.dateLabel: Thu, Aug. 27 · 8 p.m. at Kilbride Park
events.summary: The City’s free outdoor movie series ends Thursday with Ice Princess.
events.details: Access Storage Movies Under the Stars is a Thursday series. The official City schedule lists Ice Princess at Kilbride Park on August 27. Bring a chair or blanket. Weather can cancel the show; the City posts cancellations by 3 p.m. There is no verified Friday, August 28 movie night.
bring: A weather check before you leave
events.imageAlt: Editorial reconstruction of a community outdoor movie night in a park. Not a photograph of Kilbride Park.
